'''Jayke Ball DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jayke Ball]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-12127">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12127 DeckTech post 12127], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 4 December 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12127/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12127/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018100059/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12127/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

The post also lists 1x D Docking Bay, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''Hits from the Bong'''
* '''Author:''' Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball
* '''Published:''' December 4, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Better Version (in my opinion) of the ##how to Cook a Chevin deck##

=== Strategy ===

Ok, before you Ass Fucks give me a 1/2 star for copying a deck, hear me out. I simply made the deck, and changed what I saw could be flaws and helped make the deck better. I got rid of the Executor DB for coruscant because if you have noone there, they can transit and cancel visage. I aslo added another Imp. Barrier, they can save your @@$.  I ditched an emporer, you dont need 3 with 2 holonets in there. AS for the deck goes, it is a VERY powerfull deck.
